references.text: Moses commanded the people to move away from the dwellings of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, which led them to obey in verse 27.
Describes the judgment that struck Dathan and Abiram and their families who stood outside their tents when the earth opened up and swallowed them.
A recap of the rebellion of Dathan and Abiram and their fate, where they are mentioned together with Korah.
Moses reminds the Israelites of what the Lord did to Dathan and Abiram when the earth opened up and swallowed them along with their families and tents.
The psalm mentions how the earth opened up and swallowed Dathan and covered Abiram's company, and fire consumed the wicked.
The introduction to the rebellion where Korah, Dathan, and Abiram rose up against Moses and Aaron.
